title: New harnesses and different substrates
when: Later harness install, upgrade or unsupported operation
need: Install/repair only relevant native integration. A newly present harness home triggers the shared reconcile for registered checkouts and Git lanes. Repair or inspect with doctor harness-setup. Capability truth remains the installed release manifest; loading and wake capabilities differ by harness.
gap: Managed release manifests are published at .yoke/harness/<harness>/manifest.json. Automated install/refresh and byte identity are covered; real receiving-harness proof waits for release. Source tests and a scripted campaign case cover late-install reconciliation, absent homes, idempotence and durable retry state.
review: CLI versions never block installation. Install and preview reports expose harness_health separately from operational warnings. Every supported CLI reports version, floor, status ok/below_floor/probe_failed/absent, effect and next step; human output has its own health section. Runtime-health tests cover admission and both output forms; live receiving proof remains separate.
